cohort: 604 'low risk' women recruited prior to delivery
finding: Infants born by instrumental delivery for presumed fetal compromise had the poorest condition at birth (mean composite score=1.20), whereas those born by Cesarean section for presumed fetal compromise had a better condition at birth (mean composite score=0.64)
mod_finding: Mode of delivery represents a potential confounding factor when using condition at birth as a surrogate marker of intrapartum fetal compromise.
